_comment: Optional text templates for CloudShare. Copy to /opt/cloudshare/env/templates/templates.json (chmod 644) and
update the stack. Without the file the built-in texts are used. Resolution per field: users (sender address /
UPN) → groups (the sender's department in Microsoft 365) → default → built-in. Problems are logged at start.
sms_template            {password} (required), {sender_name} – GSM characters only, keep it under 160
mail_password_intro     {subject}, {sender_name}, {count} – text above the card; empty line = new paragraph
{password} is only allowed in the SMS; the SMS never contains the link or a file name.

default.sms_template: Ihr Kennwort fuer die Dateien von {sender_name}: {password}
